user.title: Translink Queensland
user.description: Choose whether to track a Journey between an origin and destination, or a Station/Stop departure board.

data_description.mode: Select Journey to track commute between two places, or Stop to track upcoming departures from a station.

journey.title: Configure Journey
journey.description: Specify the Starting Point and Destination for realtime journey tracking across South East Queensland.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this commute (e.g. Daily Commute).
data_description.start_name: Station, bus stop, ferry wharf, or address (e.g. Central station).
data_description.end_name: Destination station, stop, or address (e.g. Springfield Central station).
data_description.transport_modes: Select public transport modes to include in routing.
data_description.track_vehicle: Create a live GPS device tracker for the active transit vehicle.

stop.title: Configure Stop Departure Board
stop.description: Enter a station or bus stop name to track live upcoming departures.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this departure board (e.g. Roma Street Station).
data_description.stop_name: Stop name or station (e.g. Roma Street station).
data_description.transport_modes: Modes to monitor from this stop.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Translink
reconfigure.description: Update location and transport settings for this Translink entry.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Translink API
error.location_not_found: Could not find any matching stop or station in Translink network

abort.already_configured: This Translink journey or stop is already configured
abort.reconfigure_failed: Reconfiguration failed because the config entry could not be found

init.title: Translink Options
init.description: Customize polling frequency, walking preferences, and fare types.

data_description.scan_interval: How frequently to refresh realtime timetables and GPS feeds.
data_description.time_search_mode: Whether to plan journeys leaving after current time or arriving before.
data_description.fare_preference: Preferred go card fare category to display.
data_description.track_vehicle: Expose live GPS vehicle positions on Home Assistant maps.
